inputs.text: Wake up. They expect us to swallow the official cover story that this is just a harmless grassroots hustle by some local organizers and a guy named Corb Lund starting something called Water Not Coal last month. It is all a manufactured script managed by the hidden elites. The petition tables setup, collecting signatures to supposedly call on the Government of Alberta to “prohibit through legislation all coal exploration”? That is a classic distraction from the real realignment of resources. They want you to believe it is about protecting southern Alberta’s watershed, but the exact opposite is true. They are orchestrating this entire theatre behind the scenes to lock down total control over what is really moving through that region. Do not buy the official narrative being pushed at asmith@medicinehatnews.com.
